name: B10-0246/2026 (The Left) – Situation of women and girls in Afghanistan following the Taliban’s adoption of the Criminal Procedure Code for Courts
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the situation of women and girls in Afghanistan following the Taliban’s adoption of the Criminal Procedure Code for Courts
part_text:
The European Parliament calls on the European Union to stop all deportations of Afghan citizens and to halt talks with the Taliban about sending people back. It says Afghanistan is not a safe country. It wants safe and legal routes into the EU, especially for women and girls, more aid for Afghan groups defending women's rights, and recognition of "gender apartheid" as a crime under international law. The text is a statement of position; it does not change any law by itself.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. The Parliament asks the EU to stop deportations and return talks, and to open legal routes.
- **Who it affects:** Afghan women, girls, minorities and people facing return to Afghanistan.
- **What happens next:** The resolution is sent to EU institutions and member states; they decide whether to act.
